## Kinds with builds and no row

`sublocation` (T2) and `faction` (T3): their create verbs ship, their destroys do not, so no row is registered — registering one against an ambient process would be presence of counter-play rather than counter-play. These are the two cells every pilot brief weights first.

## Row-less templates

Templates the registry does not place. `multi_tick_project` ones fail the contract's kind-membership block (on the ratchet until placed); `instant` and `claim_control` ones may stay row-less with a `mutationHint`.
